note: Internal. What changed or broke tonight, for the weekly review. Script only.

types.NEW_SET: A TCGCSV set (group) appeared that was not there last night, or a future product in a news calendar is not on the radar.
types.NEW_RELEASE: A product appeared on the release radar or releases file.
types.RELEASE_DATE_CHANGE: A radar date changed since last night, or a news calendar shows another date for a radar product.
types.PRICE_MOVE: A single or sealed product moved 50%+ and $10+ between the last two price days (both prices $5+).
types.NEWS_SOURCE_FAILING: A news source failed or returned nothing tonight.
types.NEWS_LEAD: A news headline matched a research category: supply, grading, new product or market news.
types.DATA_GAP: A calendar day has no TCGCSV price file, or tonight's file priced 10%+ fewer products than the last one.
types.STALE_FILE: A file the reads depend on is older than its allowed age.
types.ODD_PRICE: Prices held back as likely data errors (Card Rating held list, sealed price outliers).
types.YOUTUBE_LEAD: Creator videos (official YouTube API, private store) point at something new: a set, card or sealed product on 2+ channels this week, pack-destruction or print-run talk, or a topic not seen before. Counts and dates only. An unverified lead for review, never a fact; nothing in reads or ratings uses it.
types.YOUTUBE_DISAGREE: Creators made opposite price-direction claims on one set or card inside 14 days, or our TCGplayer prices contradicted creator claims tonight. Counts and dates only.
types.YOUTUBE_KEY_MISSING: YOUTUBE_API_KEY is not set for the nightly, or the YouTube step failed. The learning loop did not run.
types.READ_TYPE_EMPTY: A known read type produced nothing tonight.
types.HYPE_EFFECT: Heavy creator attention on a set, card, or sealed product this week, with the historical 30-day move for past subjects that saw similar attention. n≥20 holdout. Counts, dates, and percent only. No creator names. Not advice.
types.CROWDED_CALL: Many tracked creators made the same-direction call on one set, card, or sealed product inside a short window, with the historical 30-day move for past crowded calls at that level. n≥20 holdout. Singles and sealed stay separate. No creator names. Not advice.
